convert_timestep_to_observations: convert a dm_env TimeStep into a mapping of player observations filtered to exclude world keys
filter_world_observations_from_space: filter a gymnasium Dict observation space to remove keys prefixed with WORLD.
convert_dm_env_spec_to_gym_space: convert a dm_env nested spec structure into a corresponding gymnasium Space hierarchy
test_spec_to_space_discrete: test spec_to_space converts a dm_env DiscreteArray spec to a gymnasium Discrete space
test_spec_to_space_bounded: test spec_to_space converts a dm_env BoundedArray spec to a gymnasium Box space with min and max bounds
